# DeMull Financial

> Fee-based fiduciary financial planning firm in Lansing, Michigan, serving business owners, tradespeople, self-employed professionals, and 401(k) plan sponsors across mid-Michigan.

## About

DeMull Financial was founded in 2023 by Sage W. DeMull, PPC (Professional Plan Consultant), who has worked in financial planning since 2015. The firm operates from 2624 Lake Lansing Rd Ste 200, Lansing, MI 48912 and serves clients throughout mid-Michigan including Lansing, East Lansing, Okemos, Haslett, Grand Ledge, DeWitt, Mason, Mt. Pleasant, and Midland. Securities and advisory services are offered through LPL Financial, member FINRA/SIPC.

The firm's core focus: most business owners are great at building their business, but very few have a clear plan for what that business is actually building for them. DeMull Financial closes that gap by connecting tax preparation, tax planning, and financial planning into one coordinated strategy.
